decisions.statement: Every page a batch names lands in one commit.
A batch whose items each name their page by one key is one question narrowed by that key's values.
A batch narrowed any other way asks after each item on its own.
A page a batch names and the store has not got is made in that same write.
Every page a batch names is read back in one question.
A row comes back for each item, in the order the items came.
An item matching several pages refuses the whole batch before anything is written.
